replies.subject: Re: A European angle on your LA architecture icons piece
replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thank you for reaching out and for your kind words about our LA
architecture roundup. If you would like to promote My Villa on our sites,
we offer sponsored placement:

Guest post on illustrarch.com: $160
It includes backlinks, you can use it as you like.

Link insertion in one of our existing articles: $110

Details
- Posts and links are permanent and dofollow.
- Post and link are not marked as sponsored.
- Published within 15 minutes after payment.
- Payment is made in advance by PayPal invoice.

If you would like to go ahead, tell us which option you prefer and we will
send the PayPal invoice.



Best Regards,

illustrarch

8 The Green STE D, Dover, DE 19901, United States

On Sun, 18 Oct 2026 18:35:42 -0700, Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi Illustrarch team,
>
> (Writing to the Illustrarch newsroom directly — this is meant for
> whichever desk is closest to the topic below. Feel free to forward as
> appropriate.)
>
> Enjoyed your roundup of LA architectural icons. Grouping Hollyhock
> House with the city landmarks is a nice reminder that LA has always
> been a canvas for borrowed traditions reinterpreted locally.
>
> A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European
> construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los
> Angeles, designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.
>
> One thought your piece sparked: much of LA enduring architecture
> absorbed European and Mediterranean instincts for proportion and
> material. That lineage, carried into resilient concrete homes, feels
> like a story worth telling.
>
> Would you be interested in receiving more material, or in a short call
> with our founder Paolo?
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
